The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] complex known as the [[Masters' Retreat]] was constructed over a '''lake''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The lake was also filled with several ruins of the ancient [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]].
